summary: onSave is now async and writes a snapshot of the in-memory note store to data/notes.json after each save.

findings.title: Async onSave breaks the synchronous dispatch caller
findings.problem: The dispatch function in src/router.js returns onSave's result without awaiting it. The server in src/main.js:9 then passes that Promise to res.end.
findings.consequence: Node's res.end throws a type error on a Promise argument, so every save request crashes the server. A failed writeFile also becomes an unhandled rejection that nothing catches.
findings.fix: Make dispatch async and have the request handler await it inside try/catch before calling res.end. The handler should answer with a 500 status when the write fails.

findings.title: New snapshot write has no covering test
findings.problem: The change makes onSave write the store to disk and return a Promise. The repository has no test for either behaviour.
findings.consequence: The broken save path in the server shipped without any test catching it. Future changes to the snapshot format can also regress unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add a test that calls dispatch with the save action. The test should check the response text and the contents of the snapshot file.
